svg.title: Classification loss functions
svg.desc: Losses L(y=1, f(x)) versus decision function f(x) from -4 to 4: zero-one loss (step from 1 to 0 at 0), hinge loss max(0, 1-f), perceptron loss max(0, -f), log loss log2(1+exp(-f)), squared hinge loss max(0, 1-f) squared, and modified Huber loss (squared hinge for f at least -1, otherwise -4f, dashed).
